name: namespace_form_declaration_matching
template:
module Admin
  class User
    def template_name
      "template"
    end
  end
end
destination:
class Admin::User
  def destination_name
    "destination"
  end
end

expected.output:
class Admin::User
  def destination_name
    "destination"
  end

  def template_name
    "template"
  end
end
